items.title: Albert Nicholas Interview, 1972-06-26
items.q: Bill Dillard, he was our first trumpet player at the time, early part.

ctx.x: What about Otis Johnson? What did he play? Third? He played third.

Played third. He didn't do any solo work. No, no. He rented the solo work. And Bill Dillard, he was our first trumpet player at the time, early part. Then Hemphill, when Louie, Hemphill, Duke Ellington, he came with us. He's a fine first trumpet player. Very good. Read all the other. See, we had two bands. We had two sets of music. One with Louie and one with our band. In the Mission, when Pop takes off In the Mission, then we go with Red Allen. Listen at this one. That's where Red would get off, you know. And…
A very interesting band. Would Louie mostly play the same program?
